test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

You need to put the baby very ______ on the bed.
solution:
The correct answer is: **gently**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gently **means with a mild, kind, or tender manner. It is an adverb.
 
• An **adverb **is used to provide more information about the verb or the action in the sentence.
 
• In the given sentence the question is "How to put the baby on the bed?" and the obvious answer will be "very gently"
 
• We use '**very**' before adverbs and adjectives to add emphasis. It means to a great degree.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **Mistake Points__**

__
 
• **Gentle **is an adjective, which means having or showing a mild, kind, or tender temperament or character.
 
• We use **adjectives **to describe nouns. Most adjectives can be used in front of a noun.
 
• We never use "very gentle" in a sentence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The word '**much**' refers to a large amount or plenty of something.
 
• The word '**more**' is the comparative degree of much/many. It means a greater amount of something. It can be used as an Adjective, an Adverb, a Noun, a Determiner, or a Pronoun.
 
• In the given sentence, "**very**" is already mentioned. So, we cannot use "**much**" and "**more**" with it.

Therefore, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is "**gently**."

Hence, the correct answer is** option 2**.

**Complete sentence:** *You need to put the baby very **gently __**on the bed.*
